headline: Public hearings on a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Hurd Street, an addition at 19 Lawton Street, and a free-standing sign at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard.
summary: The meeting will hear three requests for zoning relief. They cover a home addition at 19 Lawton Street, a sign and lighting at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard, and a 205-unit mixed-use project at 41 Hurd Street.
items: ZBA-2026-41: Variance request by Thyrin Song to construct an addition at 19 Lawton Street, for relief from side and front yard setbacks
ZBA-2026-42: Variance and special permit request by Aim Realty Medford, LLC for internal illumination and a free-standing sign at 585 Pawtucket Boulevard

ZBA-2026-43: Variance request by New England Heritage Properties, Inc to construct a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Hurd Street, for relief from ground floor use, entrance, motor vehicle access, and parking requirements
location: City Council Chambers, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852
plain_text:
City of Lowell  
Zoning Board of Appeals Agenda  
  
10/26/2026 at 6:30 PM  
  
The City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a meeting on Monday, October 26, 
2026 at 6:30 PM.  
  
Meetings will be held in the City Council Chambers  at 375 
Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852 with public welcome and by using 
remote participation as follows: 
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org, or local cable 
channel 6. Those wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item 
shall register to speak in advance of the meeting by sending an email to 
dricker@lowellma.gov,  pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov AND 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda item and a phone 
number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the meeting. If 
no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978-674-
4144. All requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
 Review all application documents online at: https://www.lowellma.gov/1099/Zoning-Board   
 
I. Continued Business 
 
  
II. New Business 
 
ZBA-2026-41 
Petition Type: Variance 
Applicant: Thyrin Song 
Property Located at: 19 Lawton Street, 01851 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 5.1 
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons  relative to an 
application by Thyrin  Song to construct an addition at 19 Lawton Street. The subject property is located in the 
Traditional Two-Family (TTF)  zoning district.  The proposal requires a Variance per Section  5.1 for relief from 
minimum side yard setbacks and the minimum front yard setback and any other relief required under the City of 
Lowell Zoning Ordinance. 
 
ZBA-2026-42 
Petition Type: Variance and Special Permit 
Applicant: Aim Realty Medford, LLC 
Property Located at: 585 Pawtucket Boulevard, 01854 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 6.3.2(9) and Section 6.3.2(8) 
Petition:  Aim Realty Medford, LLC has applied to Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals for Special Permit approval for 
internal illumination and to install a free -standing sign. The subject property is in the Suburban Mixed Use (SMU) 
zoning district. The application requires Special Permit approval under Section 6.3.2 (9) for internal illumination and
Variance approval under Section 6.3.2(8) to install a free-standing sign with each face area exceeding thirty (30) square 
feet, and for any other relief required under the Lowell Zoning Ordinance. 
 
ZBA-2026-43 
Petition Type: Variance 
Applicant: New England Heritage Properties, Inc 
Property Located at: 41 Hurd Street, 01852 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 9.8.6(1) and Section 9.8.6(7) 
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons relative to an 
application by New England Heritage Properties, Inc to construct a 205-unit mixed-use development at 41 Hurd Street. 
The subject property is located in the Downtown Mixed-Use (DMU) zoning district and Multi-Family Overlay – Mid 
Rise (MFOM) Overlay District. The project requires Variance approval per Section 9.8.6(1) for relief from the ground 
floor uses and entrance requirements, per Section 9.8.6(7) for  relief from the motor vehicle access and parking 
requirements, and for any other relief required under the Lowell Zoning Ordinance.   
 
III. Other Business 
 
Minutes for Approval:  
10/15/2026 
 
 
Per Order of the City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals – Van Pech, Chairman 
New business to be advertised by October 11, 2026 and October 18, 2026
